source.geography: ABS ASGS Edition 3 Local Government Areas 2025
source.note: Seeded from ABS LGA 2025 for Queensland, excluding statistical special-purpose codes (78 LGAs). Queensland Health reports 78 local governments. QLD uses food business licensing under the Food Act 2006 — not every food activity is licensable; check state exemption tests before labelling a council pathway as a licence requirement. notification_form_url stores the council licence application / apply page.

unincorporated.label: Primary produce / Safe Food Production Queensland
unincorporated.notes: Accredited primary production (eggs, dairy, meat, seafood schemes) sits with Safe Food Production Queensland, not the local council food business licence. Always apply the Food Act 2006 licensable-food-business test before assuming a council licence is required.

councils.name: Brisbane City Council
councils.notes: Licence types: fixed, temporary stall, mobile. Published application fees by premises size. Home-prepared market foods typically need a manufacturer licence. Not every food sale is licensable — check state exemptions first.

councils.name: Cairns Regional Council
councils.notes: Home-based licences limited to low-risk foods (e.g. cakes without fresh cream). Requires planning advice with application.

councils.name: City of Gold Coast
councils.postal_address: PO Box 5042, Gold Coast MC QLD 9726
councils.notes: Licence required to handle or prepare unpackaged food from fixed, mobile or temporary premises. Annual licences renew to 31 August.

councils.name: Ipswich City Council
councils.notes: Clear licence vs exemption list (e.g. some non-PH snack foods exempt). Temporary stall and fixed/mobile pathways published.

councils.name: Logan City Council
councils.postal_address: PO Box 3226, Logan City DC QLD 4114
councils.notes: Apply with plans and fee. Decision within 30 days. Check planning/building/plumbing approvals first. Not every activity is licensable under the Food Act 2006.

councils.name: Mackay Regional Council
councils.notes: Covers fixed, home-based, mobile and temporary stalls. Licences are not transferable on sale of business.

councils.name: City of Moreton Bay
councils.notes: Publishes clear licence vs exemption lists. Home kitchens generally need a licence for low-risk manufacture (biscuits, jam, etc.). Apply online for fixed/mobile/temporary.

councils.name: Noosa Shire Council
councils.notes: Licences renew to 31 August. Submit at least 30 business days before trading. Home-based food may need additional planning approvals.

councils.name: Redland City Council
councils.notes: Publishes who needs a licence and who does not (including some non-PH packaged foods and Safe Food Production QLD primary produce).

councils.name: Sunshine Coast Council
councils.notes: Plan assessment then licence application. Check FAQs for licence vs exemption before applying. 2026–27 plan assessment fee published as $797.

councils.name: Toowoomba Regional Council
councils.notes: Two-stage process with published fees (Stage 1 $704; Stage 2 Tier A $1310 / Tier B $704). Separate temporary one-off event licence.

councils.name: Townsville City Council
councils.notes: Licence types include commercial kitchen, domestic kitchen, mobile vehicle and temporary stall. Apply at least 30 days before trading.
